name: Banh xeo tom nhay
summary: The shrimp pancake. Báo Người Lao Động describes a thin yellow batter, small freshwater shrimp that turn red, bean sprouts, and scallion. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định, on the Mỹ Cang plate, says the shrimp is brackish tôm đất from the Thị Nại lagoon. Both stay.
origin: Quy Nhon streets on the 2 May 2019 tourism piece, and Mỹ Cang, Phước Sơn, Tuy Phước, on the provincial portal.
texture: The provincial portal says the cake is thin, with the shrimp visible, and crisp on the underside after about five minutes. Báo Người Lao Động calls the batter a thin layer.
howToEat: Báo Người Lao Động says wrap it with sprouts, cucumber, and sour star fruit, and use a fish-sauce dip. The full name in Báo Người Lao Động is bánh xèo tôm nhảy rau mầm.

The provincial portal says roll it in plain rice paper with herbs, a little mango, and cucumber, in a fish sauce with chili, garlic, lime, and sugar. It also names sour mango and a tart banana. Some molds add a few slices of beef, plus scallion, onion, bean sprouts, and straw mushroom.
Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định, on 2 May 2019, says the menu also includes squid, beef, and egg, on Diên Hồng and Đống Đa, on a cool evening. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Diên Hồng and Đống Đa, on the 2 May 2019 article from Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định.
Mỹ Cang, Phước Sơn, Tuy Phước, on the provincial portal. That is not a shop name.
seoTitle: Banh xeo tom nhay — Quy Nhon shrimp pancake
seoDescription: Bánh xèo tôm nhảy is a thin shrimp pancake. One account says freshwater shrimp. The provincial portal says Thị Nại lagoon shrimp. A price is Check on arrival.
